Dear [Madam](/person/2165)
As far as I can remember the first four tales were
[Redclyffe](/book/15)
[Heartsease](/book/19)
[Hopes and Fears](/book/37)
[Dynevor Terrace](/book/27)	
because I meant them to have some sort of analogy to the four seasons[^2]
[The Daisy Chain](/book/24)
[Trial](/book/53)
are really connected, and the [Pillars of the House](/book/109) came later but picked up on [Countess Kate](/book/44) and the Daisy Chain in the course of the story -
[Scenes and Characters](/book/3) had been written long before, but was taken up again in [Two Sides of the Shield](/book/184)where also an early story [the Stokesley Secret](/book/40)furnished some characters -
[Beechcroft At Rockstone](/book/210)
[Strolling Players](/book/229)
[The Long Vacation](/book/237)
make up the story
The others are all disconnected except
[The Chaplet of Pearls](/book/69)
[Stray Pearls](/book/170)
[The Release](/book/239) -
Some of the persons in [Magnum Bonum](/book/131) and Hopes and Fears are referred to again

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: This was on the analogy of La Motte Fouqué\'s [Die Jahrzeiten](/topic/102).
